transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started. As you all know, Harbor Point Properties has requested a restructuring of their $8 million term loan — they're asking for a 12-month maturity extension, a waiver of the current financial covenant, and release of $900,000 of equipment collateral. Before I can record the final terms, I need each of you — risk, relationship coverage, legal, and collateral management — to give me your findings update and identify the supporting document or policy behind any recommendation. I'll include those sources in the meeting minutes. Let's work through this systematically so we can determine the appropriate workout treatment. Who'd like to go first?

Our workout policy only allows a covenant waiver under these circumstances with a 9-month extension — not the 12 months they're requesting — and requires a monthly leverage certificate going forward. I also want to note that I haven't yet attached the testing file to the committee package, so I'll make sure that gets distributed after this meeting.
